title: a file named skill.md is not SKILL.md
rationale: The name is "exactly SKILL.md". On a case-insensitive filesystem a client that matches loosely will disagree with one that does not.
quote: Each immediate child directory containing a path named exactly `SKILL.md` that resolves to a regular file is treated as one skill.
observabilityNote: A case-insensitive filesystem cannot distinguish the two names, so beta is accepted either way. On a case-sensitive filesystem only alpha is conformant.
